subject: opendesign/mockups/admin-console/index.html

requirements.detail: Mockup tokens (#142e57 sidebar, #2463eb brand, #f4f6f9 canvas, #e9eef5 border, th #f8fafd / row hover #fafcff, card radius 16 / control 10 / pill 7) match the deployed overlay theme (App.vue theme object and CSS) token for token; no new design system was introduced. Screenshots show one cool-navy sidebar, one brand-blue accent (active nav pill, table sort arrow, pagination current page, primary buttons), tabular-nums on all times/sizes, consistent white cards with light borders. Login (navy brand panel + white form), sidebar and content read as one system. Tables are readable, status pills are consistent (green 已开通/开启, grey 关闭, amber 待审核). No clipping, misalignment or unreadable contrast found at 1440.

Users 1440 shows the search toolbar (搜索号码前3位、后4位或账号标识) plus the sort hint; audit 1440 shows search (搜索号码片段、操作类型或记录内容) plus the 全部动作 dropdown; 演示模板审核 / 知识内容审核 1440 show search (搜索标题、分类或说明) plus the 全部状态 filter; converter jobs search (搜索格式、结果或失败原因) is present in the deployed source (ConverterPanel.vue) and covered by the harness check 转换任务列表按格式与结果搜索, but the provided admin-converter-1440.png is cut off above the 近期转换任务 card, so that one toolbar is not visually confirmable from the supplied captures. NOTE: the users search filters phone + account id only (App.vue users computed); 实际占用 (space usage), which the requirement lists, is not searchable, and the placeholder honestly mentions only 号码/账号标识.

admin-users-1440.png shows both new columns (注册时间, 最后一次操作时间) in the expected column order. Row 1 last action 2026-10-16 23:17 is newer than row 2 2026-10-07 00:17, i.e. the default order is last-action descending; the 时间 column on the audit page is likewise 00:17 > 00:16 > 00:15. Source confirms the lastAction column carries defaultSortOrder:'descend'.

No page-level horizontal overflow at 960 or 390 (bottom-edge pixel crops of page-1-960 and page-1/5-390 show no horizontal scrollbar; layouts fit the viewport, the mobile nav collapses into a scrollable top strip, stat cards stack). NOTE 1: at 960 the 7-column users table is wider than its card and is visibly truncated at the card edge; it sits in an in-card horizontal scroll container (:scroll-x="1080"), so data is reachable, but Chromium overlay scrollbars plus no custom scrollbar styling mean the static capture shows no scroll affordance. NOTE 2: on page-5-390 the horizontally scrolled nav strip leaves the active 文档转换 pill clipped at the strip's right edge (cosmetic only). 1440 layouts have wide empty card space but no defects.

Nothing in the reviewed artifacts or the two relevant commits (7408f57 feat, b979301 docs) touches client-side files. Commit file lists contain only server/admin/overlay/App.vue, server/admin/overlay/ConverterPanel.vue, server/index.cjs, server/test/cloud.test.cjs, scripts/verify-admin-experience.cjs, docs/** and opendesign/**; no desktop/mobile sources appear. All screenshots are admin-console UI only.

notes: Audit page shows Chinese action labels (登录云空间, 审核公开内容, 提交公开申请, and 管理员 as the acting account) and masked numbers only (138****0000, 139****0000); no full phone number appears in any reviewed screenshot or in the mockup.

The production login capture renders 登录管理后台 in a pale periwinkle rather than full brand blue because the button is in its disabled state while the password field is empty (:disabled="!password||busy"); the enabled primary colour is #2463eb per the theme, so this is a state, not a palette defect.

Mockup review was done on the HTML source (browser tool unavailable: no desktop browser connected, single attempt as instructed); the mockup's structure, tokens, spacing scale and component states were compared directly against the overlay source and the captures.
Implementation and mockup agree on column order/labels, pill palette and toolbar layout; the only copy drift seen is the users subtitle (implementation adds 注册时间), which matches the new columns.

Spacing is comfortable and consistent at 1440 (34/36px page padding, 20-28px card padding); nothing appears cramped. Empty space under short tables at 1440 is a data-volume artifact, not a layout defect.
